L6: 
L7: Sept. 12, 2013
L8: 
L9: This artist's concept shows NASA's Voyager spacecraft against a backdrop of stars.
L10: 
L11: The Voyager spacecraft were built and continue to be operated by NASA's Jet Propulsion Laboratory, in Pasadena, Calif. Caltech manages JPL for NASA. The Voyager missions are a part of NASA's Heliophysics System Observatory, sponsored by the Heliophysics Division of the Science Mission Directorate at NASA Headquarters in Washington.
